items.raw_excerpt: Genau zwei Wochen vor der ersten Song-Contest-Liveshow ist am Dienstag die Bühne in der Wiener Stadthalle offiziell präsentiert worden. Auch rundherum hat sich das Areal in ein Song-Contest-Dorf verwandelt, das am Wochenende von den Delegationen aus 35 Ländern bezogen wird.
items.summary_en: Two weeks before the first live show, the Eurovision Song Contest stage at Vienna's Stadthalle was officially presented. President Alexander Van der Bellen triggered a spectacular light choreography to mark the occasion. The surrounding area has been transformed into a Song Contest Village ahead of delegations arriving from 35 countries.

items.raw_excerpt: Los hinchas de Universidad de Chile no ocultaron su molestia ante Michael Clark, quien será formalizado por administración desleal y otros cargos este próximo 30 de julio. Ante esto, los fanáticos aprovecharon el partido ante Audax Italiano para arrojar al sintético de La Florida billetes con el rostro del exmandamás de la concesionaria Azul Azul.
items.summary_en: Fans of Universidad de Chile protested against club official Michael Clark during a match at La Florida stadium. Clark faces charges of mismanagement and other offenses, with a formal hearing set for July 30. The supporters threw synthetic bills bearing his face onto the field during the game against Audax Italiano.

items.title_en: Chile university fans protest club official by throwing fake bills on pitch

items.raw_excerpt: A revista britânica Empire colocou O Agente Secreto, de Kleber Mendonça Filho, entre os cinco melhores filmes de 2026 até agora. A publicação, no entanto,
items.summary_en: Empire magazine ranked Brazilian director Kleber Mendonça Filho's film 'The Secret Agent' among the five best movies of 2026. The British publication, however, called Recife a 'small city' in its review, sparking local debate.
items.summary_ko: 영국 영화 잡지 엠파이어가 브라질 감독 클레베르 멘돈사 필류의 '비밀 요원'을 2026년 최고의 영화 5편에 포함시켰다. 그러나 이 잡지는 리뷰에서 레시피를 '소도시'라고 불러 현지 논란을 일으켰다.
